pins.name: GND
pins.notes: Black or brown wire. Also connect to the ESP32 GND

pins.name: VCC
pins.notes: Red wire. 5 to 6.8 V from a separate supply rated 3 A or more, not the ESP32

pins.name: SIG
pins.notes: White or orange wire. 50 Hz PWM, 0.5 to 2.5 ms
